title: P2 Architect: complete canonical source and use-case inventory traces
body: Separate specification/traceability work. Reconcile low reverse source claims, unclaimed inventory entries and absent use-case refs.routeIds/refs.endpointIds. Use the complete inventory populations, classify generated-source ownership explicitly, and retain source alignment and max_orphans thresholds. Producer REVIEW is a supported finding, not a missing input.
